author: Prabin Bhattarai
review_text: Very disappointed with eSewa. Rs.1000 was accidentally deposited in my account from a non-KYC account. Instead of solving, eSewa held the money. I even did KYC using my mother’s ID and requested them many times, but they only gave excuses and ignored me. They know I don’t know the sender, yet no help at all. It feels like they don’t care about small customers now. Such careless, cruel service from a big company is really heartbreaking.
